values.meaning: seconds the empower buff lasts on Jax before it lapses if his next basic attack or Leap Strike does not use it
values.binNote: No JaxW data value in the sheet exposes this 10s window; the buff is only referenced indirectly via a buff-name hash gating JaxW#FinalDamage, and that buff's own duration is not listed as a spell data value here.

mechanics.claim: Empower can be applied to either Jax's next basic attack or his next Leap Strike against an enemy, not only a plain auto-attack.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Leap Strike|Jax}}'' against an enemy within 10 seconds

mechanics.claim: Empower resets Jax's basic attack timer when it triggers.
mechanics.quote: Empower {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Jax's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Empower's bonus damage is a separate damage instance from the basic attack it rides on, not merged into the attack's own damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Empower'' is applied in a separate damage instance from '''Jax's''' basic attacks.

mechanics.claim: Empower's cooldown starts only after its effect resolves (the empowered attack or Leap Strike landing), not at the moment W is cast.
